  "motivation": "Dense item embeddings often devote much of their Euclidean distance to a few high-variance directions.   ],
  "specification": {
    "text": "Given train-only embeddings x_i in R^d, compute mu = mean_i(x_i), C = (1/N) sum_i (x_i-mu)(x_i-mu)^T, and eigendecomposition C=U diag(lambda) U^T. Set A=U diag((lambda+alpha*mean(lambda))^(-1/2)) U^T, with fixed alpha=0.05. Train the unchanged RQ-VAE on z_i=A(x_i-mu) with its existing reconstruction, commitment, and codebook losses; at export, encode each item's same z_i and write its ordinary single code tuple. Do not fit A using validation/test items or labels."
  },
  "title": "Whiten item semantics before residual quantization"
